info.title: Cosmos API
info.description: The Cosmos REST API. Guides, authentication and the changelog are at /developers.

bearerPat.description: A Cosmos API key or personal access token: `Authorization: Bearer cosmos_<prefix>_<secret>`. What it can do is its scopes intersected with its user's own permissions.

ApiVersion.name: Cosmos-API-Version
ApiVersion.description: The API version to run at (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Without it, a token runs at the version it was minted under and a browser session at the current one, 2026-11-01. An unknown version is a 400, a retired one a 410 (`unsupported_api_version`).

orgId.description: The organization the token is bound to.

token.description: Present when the request authenticated with a token.

type.description: Relative URI of this code in the errors guide.

requestId.description: The `X-Request-Id` of the request. Quote it to support.

error.description: Deprecated: same text as `detail` (or `title`). Kept for existing clients.

prefix.description: Shown as `cosmos_<prefix>_…` so you can tell tokens apart.

projectIds.description: Projects it is limited to; empty means every project you can reach.

token.description: The secret, shown this once. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

userId.description: Null for actions taken by the system.

typeBindings.description: Work-item types it applies to; empty means every type.
